discovery.title: CelluWeave A: Wet compression of cellulose–alginate sheets
discovery.shortDescription: This study evaluated the compressive modulus, shape retention, and water uptake of cellulose-alginate hydrogel sheets crosslinked with 50 mmol/L and 75 mmol/L calcium chloride.

discovery.title: CelluWeave B：湿态压缩条件与测量时点
discovery.shortDescription: This study reports that a hydrogel formulation of 2.0% sodium alginate and 0.8% cellulose, crosslinked with 50 mmol/L calcium chloride, exhibits an average compressive modulus of 48.0 kPa at 15% strain and a shape retention rate of 94%.

discovery.title: CelluWeave C: Added cellulose and swelling tradeoffs
discovery.shortDescription: This study characterizes a nonliving hydrogel composed of 2.0% w/v alginate and 1.2% w/v cellulose, reporting a mean compressive modulus of 51.0 kPa and water uptake of 12.5 g/g.

discovery.title: CelluWeave evidence map: Three small synthetic studies
topics: review of P17, P31, and P52
discovery.shortDescription: A narrative review summarizing strain conditions for papers P17, P31, and P52.

discovery.title: CelluWeave D：低温储存后的可逆性
discovery.shortDescription: This study evaluated a sodium alginate and cellulose hydrogel, finding that after 7 days of storage at 4°C, it retained 95% of its shape and experienced only an 8% decrease in compression modulus.

discovery.title: EctD A163V: Temperature-controlled kinetic and titer study
discovery.shortDescription: Characterization of EctD variant A163V showing a reduced Km for ectoine (0.42 mM vs 0.80 mM for wild-type) and specific fermentation metrics including a titer of 4.80 g/L at 30°C.

discovery.title: EctD T212S：35°C 条件下的产物滴度与动力学
discovery.shortDescription: This paper reports the characterization of mutant T212S using tetrahydropyrimidine as a substrate at 35°C, providing data on Km, titer, specific activity, yield, and productivity, and comparing these results to P117.

discovery.title: EctD variants at 42°C: Opposing activity and titer rankings
discovery.shortDescription: A comparison of A163V and T212S variants at 42°C for the production of 羟基四氢嘧啶 showed that T212S had higher specific activity (2.40 U/mg) while A163V had a higher product titer (4.60 g/L).
